report.summary: Promotion preconditions in order: 1) Source refresh succeeds (refresh_sources returns succeeded=True for map). 2) A candidate is selected (non-null task_id and attempt). 3) Gate discrimination is proven (gate_discrimination returns proven=True). Currently, condition 3 is false: no valid discrimination receipt exists (rejection rate 0/3), so promotion_allowed is False. ShadowResult.promotion_allowed checks only discrimination.proven, which is the final conditional gate.
risks: Gate_discrimination revision check previously failed open; regression risk.
ShadowResult.promotion_allowed does not validate source freshness, trusting earlier steps not to proceed.
todos: Verify gate_discrimination revision check cannot fail open.
Consider explicit source-freshness validation in promotion_allowed.

handoff.suggestion: Document the exact precondition chain in ShadowResult docstring and ensure each precondition is asserted within the promotion_allowed property or the calling shadow_run function.
